observed.failure: Actual rendered opaque interior did not hit original SceneKit geometry

inference.statement: The direct raw Metal readback row-to-SCNRenderer query mapping is contradicted by this asymmetric opaque miss and independently transparent vertical-mirror geometry hit. A single fixed Y conversion is the smallest correction consistent with the observed pair. The exact selected entity and roundtrip remain unproved until fresh execution.
alternativeAssessment: A wholly absent or unprepared graph does not explain the actual mirror geometry hit.
The viewport assertion passed and the populated PNG is byte-identical to the preceding accepted raster run.
The completed render advanced the presentation hierarchy after SCNTransaction.flush; no animation/scene/camera replacement was introduced in this increment.
The failure alone does not prove a production touch-coordinate defect or any physical AR behavior.

minimalProposal.scope: Existing fixture only; no production renderer, mapper, contracts, test declarations or timing changes
minimalProposal.mapping: For the existing asserted origin-zero 256x256 target, rendererPoint = (readbackPixelCenter.x, viewport.height - readbackPixelCenter.y). Apply this fixed mapping exactly once to opaque, mirror, background and all removed queries. Never retry or choose mappings based on a hit.
minimalProposal.roundtrip: Compare projectPoint(hit.worldCoordinates) to the converted SceneKit query point, then apply the same involution back to Metal readback space and require correspondence with the original alpha-safe pixel.
minimalProposal.report: Retain raw readback pixel centers and add explicit SceneKit query centers plus mapping; preserve original PNG/report attachments and failed receipt.

Transparent mirror/background and all three removed-graph misses with retained old-root lookup

primarySources.finding: Query coordinates belong to the receiver screen/view/layer/GPU viewport space; method searches real scene geometry.
Returned coordinates belong to the receiver screen/view/layer/GPU viewport space.
Metal viewport originX/originY describe the upper-left corner. This does not separately guarantee that SCNRenderer query Y equals raw Metal readback row Y.
